title: The menu you pause into
summary: Pausing in Supermarket Simulator opens a menu of its own: the game keeps an escape menu, a manager for its tabs and a second one for sub-tabs, plus kinds for leaving and for the transition between screens.
body: Pausing is a screen rather than a freeze. The game has an escape menu of its own, so stopping play opens something built for that purpose instead of leaving you in the shop with the controls off.
The menu is divided by tabs. Tabs are run by a manager of their own, which is why the pause menu can hold several pages without each one being built separately.
There is a second level. Sub-tabs have their own manager, so a page inside the pause menu can have its own divisions rather than everything sitting on one screen.
Leaving is typed. There are kinds of quitting, which is why going back to the main menu and closing the game can be offered as different things rather than one button that does whatever it does.
Screens change in a way the game has named. Transitions are typed as well, so the movement between one screen and the next is chosen rather than happening by accident.
What this entry does not tell you: what each tab holds, how long a transition takes, or which kinds of quitting are offered in a given build. We have not verified those, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Pausing opens an escape menu of its own.
The menu's tabs are run by a manager of their own.
Sub-tabs have a manager of their own.
Transitions between screens are typed as well.
The game draws a pause icon of its own for the menus.
The build ships a variant of the escape menu for multiplayer.
facts.evidence: asset name: Escape Menu Multiplayer Variant

facts.claim: The menu set also names pictograms for back, play, next, previous and sound on.
facts.evidence: asset names: Icon_PictoIcon_Back, Icon_PictoIcon_Play, Icon_PictoIcon_Next02, Icon_PictoIcon_Prev02, Icon_PictoIcon_Sound_on

facts.claim: The menu itself is drawn as a grid of four rounded squares.
The pictogram set also names wifi, a search mark, music and an information image.
facts.evidence: asset names: Icon_PictoIcon_Wifi, Icon_PictoIcon_Search, Icon_PictoIcon_Music_on, Icon_ImageIcon_Info
